# Comfy Kling 4.0- Reference to Video

Hold a character and a location from two reference images and shoot a three-shot fashion fragment between them: an extreme close-up with a snap zoom, a mid-hall turn with a whip-pan, and a 120-degree orbit under the arched window. Each cut lands on a new position inside the same room, with two hard cuts in five seconds and stereo audio generated for the space. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_kling4_r2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.reference_images:
Three shots, hard cuts on the beat. Fashion-editorial / MV title fragment inside the brutalist hall from @Image2; the woman from @Image1 keeps her orange-red bob, freckles, burgundy lips, camel leather trench, black turtleneck, wide black trousers and boots exactly as they are. Do not change the hall: dark concrete walls, stone bench, arched window, hard golden god-ray and dust in the beam.

0-1.5s: extreme close-up of her face filling the frame, god-ray rim light on her hair and cheek; she looks dead into camera with a small confident almost-smile, then a tiny decisive chin tilt; fast snap zoom-in on her eyes then hard hold.
1.5-3.2s: hard cut - she is now standing mid-hall inside the golden beam beside the stone bench (new position); medium-wide; she turns on her heel, trench coat flares, and walks two sharp steps toward camera; whip-pan left with her motion then stops.
3.2-5s: hard cut - centered in the thickest part of the god-ray under the arched window (new position); medium three-quarter; both arms relaxed at her sides, no pockets; camera makes a smooth 120° orbit right around her as she holds a still fashion stare into lens, dust sparkling in the beam, ending locked on a clean beauty frame.

Each shot has its own camera move; never one continuous slow pan. Sound: coat leather rustle, boot heel on stone, soft hall reverb; no dialogue, no subtitles.
